notes.title: Arthur Loves Watermelon Demo patch: 1.0.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
The first thing I want to do is thank you for downloading the demo. As some of you may have noticed, despite my effort to launch the game with the "zero bugs" philosophy, a few have popped up from under the rocks. But don’t worry!

PATCH NOTES:

- A translation error has been fixed.

- A bug has been fixed that prevented you from unlocking the 100% Demo skin.

- A bug has been fixed that prevented you from enjoying the third world’s soundtrack, as it played the second world’s soundtrack instead.

- Some songs no longer cut off when you die.

- The number of watermelons per square meter has been increased.
